title: Dior Sauvage Alternatives From Real Fragrance Houses, Not Clones
seo_title: Dior Sauvage Alternatives From Real Houses | Base Note
seo_description: Five fragrances that share official notes with Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum, from Creed, YSL, Parfums de Marly, Prada and Versace. Alternatives, not clones.
summary: Five fragrances from Creed, YSL, Parfums de Marly, Prada and Versace that share at least one official note with Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum, each set against Dior's own note list. It also explains how an alternative differs from a clone and compares Sauvage with Creed Aventus note by note.
tags: dior sauvage alternative not a clone
direct_answer: Creed Green Irish Tweed shares the most official notes with Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum: bergamot, lavender and ambroxan. YSL Y Eau de Parfum Intense shares lavender, Parfums de Marly Perseus and Prada Paradigme share bergamot, and Versace Eros Eau de Parfum shares vanilla. Each one is a separate fragrance with its own maker's note list, so treat them as alternatives, not copies.

outline.text: Dior Sauvage Alternatives From Real Fragrance Houses, Not Clones
Direct answer paragraph, exactly the direct_answer field, starting Direct answer:.

points: At most 60 words a 12-year-old follows. A fragrance is made from a recipe of smells.
A clone tries to copy another fragrance's recipe. An alternative is a different recipe that uses some of the same smells, such as bergamot or lavender in Sauvage.
No brand names other than Dior, no performance words.

outline.text: What does Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum smell like?
points: Dior's current page: Calabrian bergamot on top; Sichuan pepper, lavender and star anise in the heart; vanilla extract from Papua New Guinea and ambroxan in the base. Define note, and top, heart and base notes, the first time they appear (order only: first impression, then the defining heart, then the base; Creed's pages define the layers this way, cite Creed if the definition is attributed). Link the notes guide here.

Maker's descriptive words usable verbatim: the bergamot is 'fruitier than other bergamots and develops slightly peppery and zesty facets'; the vanilla has 'smoky accents'; the inspiration is 'the desert in the magical hour of twilight'; the product line reads 'Citrus and Vanilla Notes'. Do NOT quote 'powerful and noble trail', 'bold and refined', 'balanced and versatile', 'magnetic trail' or any hours or spray guidance from the same page.

Define ambroxan from Wikipedia: ambroxide, widely known by the brand name Ambroxan, is one of the key constituents responsible for the odor of ambergris, has woody, musky and slightly salty nuances, and is synthesized from sclareol, a component of clary sage oil. Do not use the word fixative.

Optional context, one sentence at most: WWD reports that the Sauvage line ranks first among all fragrances, masculine and feminine combined, a decade after its 2015 launch, and that the Eau de Parfum followed the Eau de Toilette in 2018. Never repeat WWD's unit counts or 'every 30 seconds' figure.

outline.text: What is the difference between a Sauvage alternative and a Sauvage clone?
points: Clone, attributed to PairFum: 'a perfume that replicates, copies or imitates the scent of a well-known, popular and expensive luxury fragrance'. Say that PairFum treats clone, dupe and copycat as the same thing.

NPR: companies that make dupes 'openly advertise them as being "inspired by" more expensive alternatives' and they are not knock-offs claiming to be the brand-name perfume; fragrance makers use gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GCMS) to identify the specific molecules in a competitor's fragrance, which NPR calls a crucial step to creating a believable dupe. Define GCMS in plain words (a lab test that separates a scent into its molecules and names them). Write 'gas chromatography mass spectrometry' without a hyphen if a dash-like join is a risk; a normal hyphen is allowed, no en dash.

Alternative, our editorial definition: a separate fragrance with its own published note list that shares some notes or a note family with Sauvage. Ground 'note family' in the Perfume Society: fougere fragrances 'almost invariably feature lavender, geranium, vetiver, bergamot, oakmoss and coumarin'; the fresh family features notes such as 'lemon, bergamot, orange, grapefruit, mandarin'. Sauvage's official list includes two of those fougere materials (bergamot, lavender); do not call Sauvage a fougere, no fetched source says so.

State plainly that this guide names no clone brands or clone products and makes no claim about how clones smell or compare. Do not use NPR's 'professionals would have difficulty telling them apart' line.

outline.text: How do Dior Sauvage and Creed Aventus compare?
outline.why: Questions lane: 'dior sauvage vs creed aventus' is the highest-volume head-to-head in autocomplete ('is dior sauvage or creed aventus better', 'creed aventus vs dior sauvage which is better').
points: Creed's page: Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian lemon and blackcurrant leaf accord (head); pineapple accord, pink pepper and jasmine accord (heart); birch, patchouli and musk accord (base). Creed's words usable verbatim: 'fresh Calabrian bergamot, smoky birch and an iconic pineapple accord'. Define accord (a blend of materials built to smell like one thing).

Shared on both official pages: Calabrian bergamot, named identically. Both also name a pepper, but different ones: Sichuan pepper in Sauvage, pink pepper in Aventus. Say this plainly without calling it a shared note.
Where they part: Aventus has pineapple, blackcurrant leaf, jasmine, birch, patchouli and musk; Sauvage has lavender, star anise, vanilla and ambroxan, none of which appear on Creed's Aventus list.

Answer 'which is better' by refusing a ranking: the note lists show what each is built from; which one you prefer is for your skin to decide. Link the live Aventus review. Aventus is not one of the five picks and gets no h3.

outline.text: How can you try these side by side?
points: Compare two at a time: Sauvage on one wrist, one alternative on the other, rather than all five at once.
Before smelling, read both official note lists and look for the shared note (bergamot, lavender, ambroxan or vanilla). Then notice where the two go apart.

Smell again later in the day, because the first impression comes from the top notes and the base arrives last. No spray counts, no hours, no statements about how long anything stays or how far it reaches.
Keep a two-line note on your phone for each pairing. Link the sample-before-you-buy post.

faq.q: What smells like Dior Sauvage but is not a clone?
faq.answer_points: Separate fragrances whose official note lists share notes with Sauvage: Green Irish Tweed (bergamot, lavender, ambroxan), Y Eau de Parfum Intense (lavender), Perseus and Paradigme (bergamot), Eros Eau de Parfum (vanilla).

faq.q: What is the difference between a fragrance clone and an alternative?
faq.answer_points: PairFum's clone definition (replicates, copies or imitates a well-known luxury fragrance); an alternative is a different recipe with its own note list that shares some notes.

faq.q: Is a fragrance dupe the same as a fake?
faq.answer_points: NPR: dupe makers openly advertise their products as 'inspired by' the original; they are not knock-offs claiming to be the brand-name perfume. No legal advice, no quality claims.

faq.q: Is Dior Sauvage or Creed Aventus better?
faq.answer_points: No ranking. Both name Calabrian bergamot; Aventus builds on pineapple and birch, Sauvage on pepper, lavender, vanilla and ambroxan. Compare them on your own skin.

faq.q: What is the difference between Dior Sauvage and YSL Y Intense?
faq.answer_points: Shared lavender; YSL adds blue juniper berries and patchouli from Bali, Dior has Calabrian bergamot, Sichuan pepper, star anise, vanilla and ambroxan. Nothing about versatility.

faq.q: What is ambroxan, and which of these alternatives contain it?
faq.answer_points: Wikipedia definition (ambergris odor constituent; woody, musky, slightly salty; made from sclareol from clary sage). Of the five picks, only Creed Green Irish Tweed lists it; Aventus does not; Versace lists AmberMax, a different material, so do not equate them.
